# RWTAM golden wave6 fixture

Wave6 is retained as the fixture name after the 2026-07-04 tdcest beta-dial
refresh. This is a deliberate headline-affecting refreeze: forward TDC beta
moved from the D3 post-drain recommendation `0.20` to the tdcest current point
estimate `0.342`, with D3 retained as historical regime evidence.

The object stamp remains `current_default_wave6_curve_consistency` because the
curve/tax construction did not change; only the sanctioned TDC beta authority
changed.
